fact: The IMF mission of July-August 2023 reports 16 modules of the Egyptian Tax Authority's Integrated Tax Core System rolled out in major tax offices.

The Egyptian Cabinet spokesman said the government Payroll system for state administrative-body staff pay had been activated in 2,281 of 2,675 target accounting units, with a further 111 units of economic authorities and bodies moved to the New Administrative Capital also covered.

The Ministry of Finance's electronic payment and collection unit head says governance of the linkage between the Electronic Payment and Collection Centre and the Government Financial Management Information System (GFMIS) is being strengthened.

The Egyptian Tax Authority head says a unified platform computes wage and salary tax electronically for employers across all sectors and passes the claim electronically to the authority's comprehensive mechanisation system for payment.
